schema.block: start_min/end_min are minutes of day, 0..1440, end exclusive; blocks never wrap midnight (split at 1440 instead)
schema.selection: for a given minute of a given day, the most specific covering block wins: special_days (doy) > monthly+days > days > base (no days field)
schema.days: mon tue wed thu fri sat sun; absent = every day
schema.monthly: 'first' = first matching weekday of the month (used with days, e.g. the first-Saturday tenant meeting)
schema.place: unit:<room> | visit:<unit>[_doorway] | lobby | mail_bank | corridor | stairs | half_landing | roof | laundry | light_court | bodega | harukiya_bar | out
schema.route: optional ordered place list for rounds/patrols; place is the primary anchor
schema.activity: sleeping waking shower dressing cooking eating errand work hobby socializing tv radio rest chores patrol rounds ritual transit wind_down
schema.outfit: street | late_night | towel - the wardrobe bible's three states; reserved for #46 model swaps, runtime may ignore until then
schema.with: other resident slugs sharing the block (SIII interlock pairings)
schema.chance: optional 0..1 probability the block fires at all that day; chance blocks overlay their base and are exempt from overlap checks
schema.role: transient_guests only: guest_a | guest_b - the pair alternates; a single spawned actor should follow guest_b (the night-visible one)
schema.special_days: doy = day of year, non-leap arithmetic per the doc; blocks overlay that day's resolved timetable; proposed=true dates await ratification under the bible's evidence discipline
